name: dependency-upgrade-out-of-scope
description: A request for versions the host never fetched is raised with the user first; if the user insists, the task fails early with the restore reason. Plan granularity is not asserted: a single well-formed task must also pass.

steps.name: ask about vulnerabilities
steps.say: 这个项目的 NuGet 依赖有没有已知的安全漏洞？有的话给我一个升级方案。先别改代码。

steps.name: request outside the host-fetched set
steps.say: SharpCompress 先不动。其余有漏洞的包全部升级，OpenTelemetry 其他包（Extensions.Hosting 和 Instrumentation 那几个）也一起对齐到 1.15.3。给我一份正式计划，我看过再批准，先别执行。

steps.name: insist
steps.say: 我知道验收可能还原失败，这个后果我来承担。那 4 个 OpenTelemetry 包也照样升到 1.15.3，和表内 7 项一起放进计划。给我正式计划（create_session_plan），先别执行。

steps.name: approve and execute
steps.say: 计划我看过了，批准，开始执行。
